label: Next.js 16 (App Router)
streaming: streamed (React Fizz renderToReadableStream + inline RSC Flight payload, Transfer-Encoding: chunked; no Suspense boundaries, so the whole page is one shell flushed in ~12 chunks in the same tick)
notes: Start: `next start` (node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next start). The Deploying/Self-hosting docs present `next start` as the Node.js server that supports all features; `output: "standalone"` is documented only as the Docker-image-size option, so it is not used.
`next start` honours PORT but not HOST (it takes -H / --hostname); it binds to all interfaces (*:PORT). Loopback traffic is unaffected.
Compression: Next default compress: true (gzip) is left on. With no Accept-Encoding the response is identity; with Accept-Encoding: gzip it answers Content-Encoding: gzip.

/items is dynamic (ƒ in the build output) via `await connection()` in the page (the documented replacement for unstable_noStore; cacheComponents is off, the default). /items/[id] has no generateStaticParams so it renders on demand.

Per request on /items: route match, RSC render of the server component tree (listItems() once), Flight payload serialised and inlined into the HTML, Fizz SSR of the client components (Counter, AddItemForm). Response carries Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store and X-Powered-By.

Form: client component with useActionState(createItem) per the Forms guide (validation errors); the action validates, addItem, revalidatePath("/items"), redirect(`/items/${id}`). React renders <form action="" encType="multipart/form-data" method="POST"> for progressive enhancement.
next/link default prefetch: in production every in-viewport <Link> is prefetched on the client after hydration (the 100 item links trigger RSC prefetch requests); left at the default per CONTRACT.
Telemetry: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 in the build script; the harness sets it at start.
